source_card_updates.title: Compiling Differentiable Audio Graphs to Real-Time DSP
source_card_updates.bounded_summary: ADAC preserves the evaluated integer-delay LTI graph transfer function through a JSON-to-FAUST compiler and attaches a sufficient small-gain stability certificate. The demonstrated equivalence and stability claims do not cover nonlinear or time-varying processors.

verified_facts.evaluated_graph_class: LTI FDN plus reported SDN example
verified_facts.tests_reported: 201 unit tests plus end-to-end IR integration suite
verified_facts.benchmark_context: Apple M2 single core at 48 kHz
verified_facts.certificate_type: sufficient small-gain bound on emitted single-precision coefficients plus recursive-section pole checks

limits: No listening test or rock mix evaluation.
LTI proof does not cover compression, clipping, envelope following or modulation.
CPU and hot-reload figures are hardware, host and version dependent.
Current fractional-delay code path postdates the paper's rounded-delay description and lacks paper-level equivalence evidence.

source_card_updates.title: Explicit Wave Digital Model of the Fulltone OCD Pedal Based on Canonical Piecewise-Linear Functions
source_card_updates.bounded_summary: A CPWL explicit WDF approximates the Fulltone OCD v2 clipping circuit and is much faster than the compared iterative WDF in the authors' MATLAB test. Synthetic circuit-simulation fit and informal listening do not establish hardware identity, alias-free behavior or mix preference.

verified_facts.illustrative_test: 1 s, 1 kHz, 1 V sine at 96 kHz
verified_facts.runtime_context: 100 MATLAB runs on Apple M1 Pro

limits: No controlled blind or loudness-matched listening test.
No measured hardware validation across devices, tolerances and controls.
Antiderivative antialiasing is proposed as future work; alias-free behavior is not shown.
Companion repository has no explicit licence file and was not executed.

version_drift: Paper rounds fractional delays; current code preserves fractions and emits de.fdelay with linear interpolation.
Paper reports sub-10-ms plugin recompilation; current README says about 100 ms.

knowledge_cards.claim: ADAC's demonstrated equivalence is bounded to its tested LTI graph/operator subset and integer-delay evaluation.
Full MIMO IR residual, direct-path timing and absolute arrival time are required to verify compiled LTI graph equivalence.
A small-gain certificate is sufficient but not necessary; an unproven verdict is not proof of instability.
Stability analysis must use the exact emitted precision and coefficients, not pristine training values alone.
Bounded semantic macro-controls are safer than exposing independently movable trained coefficients.
Compiler version drift can invalidate a paper-level equivalence claim for newly supported operators such as fractional delay.
The explicit CPWL OCD model reduces computational cost relative to the tested iterative WDF under one published setup.
Circuit-simulation agreement does not establish identity to physical hardware across tolerances and controls.
Nonlinear-model accuracy, aliasing, playability, mix fit and listener preference are independent evaluation axes.
A paper's CC BY licence does not supply a missing licence for its companion source repository.

rule_candidates.when: compiling a differentiable LTI audio graph
rule_candidates.change: pin commit, operator inventory, sample rate and numeric precision
rule_candidates.cancel: if any version or operator is unresolved

rule_candidates.change: compare complete MIMO IR without alignment including direct paths and timing
rule_candidates.cancel: on unexplained offset or residual beyond documented bound

rule_candidates.change: treat small-gain result as sufficient-only and preserve verdict vocabulary
rule_candidates.cancel: on unstable, not-certified or indeterminate without manual review

rule_candidates.when: processor contains nonlinear or time-varying nodes

rule_candidates.change: use bounded semantic macro-controls instead of raw trained coefficients
rule_candidates.cancel: if any control setting breaks bounds or quality

rule_candidates.change: separate circuit fit, aliasing, runtime and loudness-matched preference
rule_candidates.protect: intended harmonic colour, attack and mix role
rule_candidates.verify: synthetic analysis plus blind guitar/full-mix A/B
rule_candidates.cancel: if technical gain fails perceptual or stability criteria

rule_candidates.change: require explicit repository licence and local reproduction
rule_candidates.verify: licence file, pinned commit and repeatable test
rule_candidates.cancel: while licence or reproduction is unresolved

revised_conclusions: ADAC equivalence and stability guarantees narrowed from generic differentiable audio graphs to the demonstrated LTI operator subset.
ADAC fractional-delay support in current code is not covered by the paper's integer-delay equivalence evidence.
OCD model's circuit-simulation fit and runtime improvement do not prove alias-free behavior or listener preference.
